title: All-purpose Korean Marinade
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 cup corn syrup (or Korean Oligodang) (or use 2/3 cup honey or 1 more cup sugar)
1  large onion, roughly cut into small pieces
1  large apple, roughly cut into small pieces
12 to 14  plump garlic cloves, roughly cracked oped (use a side of the knife)
2 inch long ginger (about 1 inch diameter), thinly sliced
1 cup rice wine (or mirin)  (Dry white wine is also good.)
ldInstructionsRaw: Add all the ingredients (except the dashima, rice wine, and lemon) to a large pot with 6 cups of water. Bring it to a boil over high heat, uncovered, and then reduce the heat to achieve a medium boil (between medium high and medium on my stove). Boil for 30 minutes.
Add the dashima and continue to boil for 10 more minutes.
Remove all the solids with a strainer.
Add the rice wine and lemon slices, and let it cool. Store in a jar(s) in the fridge.
